data.title: Medicare Inpatient Hospitals - by Provider and Service Data Dictionary

fields.name: Rndrng_CCN
fields.label: Rendering Provider CCN
fields.description: The CMS Certification Number (CCN) of the provider billing for inpatient hospital services.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_St
fields.label: Rendering Provider Street Address
fields.description: The street address in which the provider is physically located.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_City
fields.label: Rendering Provider City
fields.description: The city in which the provider is physically located.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_State_Abrvtn
fields.label: Rendering Provider State Abbreviation
fields.description: The state abbreviation for the state in which the provider is physically located.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_State_FIPS
fields.label: Rendering Provider State FIPS Code
fields.description: The state FIPS code for the state in which the provider is physically located.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_Zip5
fields.label: Rendering Provider Zip Code
fields.description: The zip code in which the provider is physically located.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_RUCA
fields.label: Rendering Provider Rural-Urban Commuting Code
fields.description: The Rural-Urban Commuting Area (RUCA) code for the zip code in which the provider is physically located. RUCA codes classify zip codes as rural/urban areas based on measures of population density, level of urbanization, and daily commuting patterns. These codes are developed by United States Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service.

fields.name: Rndrng_Prvdr_RUCA_Desc
fields.label: Rendering Provider Rural-Urban Commuting Area Description
fields.description: The description of the RUCA code. RUCA codes classify zip codes as rural/urban areas based on measures of population density, level of urbanization, and daily commuting patterns. These codes are developed by United States Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service.

fields.name: DRG_Cd
fields.label: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) Definition
fields.description: Classification system that groups similar clinical conditions (diagnoses) and the procedures furnished by the hospital during the stay.

fields.name: DRG_Desc
fields.label: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) Description
fields.description: Description of the classification system (DRG) that groups similar clinical conditions (diagnoses) and the procedures furnished by the hospital during the stay.

fields.name: Tot_Dschrgs
fields.label: Total Discharges
fields.description: The number of discharges billed by all providers for inpatient hospital services.

fields.name: Avg_Submtd_Cvrd_Chrg
fields.label: Average Covered Charges
fields.description: The average charge of all providers' services covered by Medicare for discharges in the DRG. These will vary from hospital to hospital because of differences in hospital charge structures.

fields.name: Avg_Tot_Pymt_Amt
fields.label: Average Total Payments
fields.description: The average total payments to all providers for the DRG including the MS-DRG amount, teaching, disproportionate share, capital, and outlier payments for all cases. Also included in average total payments are co-payment and deductible amounts that the patient is responsible for and any additional payments by third parties for coordination of benefits.

fields.name: Avg_Mdcr_Pymt_Amt
fields.label: Average Medicare Payments
fields.description: The average amount that Medicare pays to the provider for Medicare's share of the MS-DRG. Medicare payment amounts include the MS-DRG amount, teaching, disproportionate share, capital, and outlier payments for all cases. Medicare payments DO NOT include beneficiary co-payments and deductible amounts nor any additional payments from third parties for coordination of benefits.
